notes: veg and gf flags mean typically/usually; recipes vary by cook. Seasons per Belize Fisheries Department notices.

dishes.name: Rice and beans
dishes.short: Red kidney beans and rice cooked together in coconut milk, the base of the national plate.

dishes.name: Stew chicken
dishes.short: Chicken browned and simmered in a dark red sauce colored with recado.

dishes.name: Fry jacks
dishes.short: Puffed pillows of fried dough, filled or served with beans, eggs and cheese.

dishes.name: Johnny cakes
dishes.short: Small, dense baked rounds made with coconut milk, split and filled at breakfast.

dishes.name: Boil up
dishes.short: Fish or salted pig tail with cassava, plantain, sweet potato, eggs and dumplings under a tomato sauce.

dishes.name: Cow foot soup
dishes.short: A rich, gelatinous soup of cow foot, vegetables and dumplings, often a weekend special.

dishes.name: Meat pies
dishes.short: Small flaky pies of seasoned minced meat sold at shops and carts.

dishes.name: Hudut
dishes.short: Fish in coconut broth (sere) with mashed plantain (fu-fu).

dishes.name: Ereba (cassava bread)
dishes.short: Thin, crisp bread of grated, dried cassava.

dishes.name: Darasa
dishes.short: Green banana grated and wrapped in leaves, a Garifuna tamale.

dishes.name: Bundiga
dishes.short: Green banana and coconut, in the same family as hudut.

dishes.name: Salbutes
dishes.short: Puffed fried corn tortillas topped with shredded chicken, cabbage and tomato.

dishes.name: Garnaches
dishes.short: Crisp corn tortillas with refried beans, cheese and pickled onion.

dishes.name: Panades
dishes.short: Fried corn turnovers filled with fish or beans, with onion relish.

dishes.name: Escabeche
dishes.short: Chicken in a sharp onion-and-vinegar broth with corn tortillas.

dishes.name: Relleno (black dinner)
dishes.short: Dark soup made with black recado, often with chicken and stuffed pork.

dishes.name: Tamales and bollos
dishes.short: Corn dough with seasoned meat, wrapped in banana leaf and steamed.

dishes.name: Caldo
dishes.short: A simple, restorative Maya soup, usually chicken with vegetables and corn tortillas.

dishes.name: Corn tortillas
dishes.short: Hand-pressed and naturally gluten-free, on almost every Belizean table.

dishes.name: Belizean chocolate
dishes.short: Bean-to-bar chocolate from Belizean cacao, tasted on farm tours in Toledo and Cayo.

dishes.name: Ceviche
dishes.short: Shrimp, fish or conch cured in lime with onion, tomato, cilantro and habanero.
dishes.season: Conch only in season (October to June, quota permitting).

dishes.name: Conch fritters
dishes.short: Chopped conch in batter, fried crisp.

dishes.name: Grilled lobster
dishes.short: Spiny lobster grilled with garlic butter, or in tacos and pasta.
dishes.season: July 1 to end of February only.

dishes.name: Whole fried snapper
dishes.short: Reef fish fried whole, served with rice and beans or coconut rice.

dishes.name: Gibnut
dishes.short: Paca, a large rodent; slow-cooked and nicknamed "the royal rat".

dishes.name: Belikin beer
dishes.short: The national beer, brewed in Belize.

dishes.name: Rum punch
dishes.short: Local rum with fruit juices, the classic beach drink.

dishes.name: Seaweed shake
dishes.short: A creamy blend of seaweed, milk, cinnamon and nutmeg; more pleasant than it sounds.

dishes.name: Fresh fruit juice
dishes.short: Watermelon, lime, orange, soursop or pineapple, blended to order.

dishes.name: Rum cake
dishes.short: A moist cake soaked with Belizean rum, a popular gift and dessert.

dishes.name: Coconut tart
dishes.short: Sweet pastry filled with grated coconut, sold at bakeries.
